summary: Provides the Optimize-Assemblies PowerShell function, which uses ngen.exe to install native images for loaded Microsoft.PowerShell assemblies. Since every Windows module uses PowerShell, this cuts the startup overhead of each task.
questions: What script do I run to ngen PowerShell assemblies?
How do I reduce per-task overhead on Windows hosts?
Where is ngen.exe located for the optimization?
Why does PowerShell startup time matter for Ansible?

answer_card.title: Speeding up PowerShell startup with ngen
